entry: 构建与运行 → 场景动画

ownership.pureDraft: one track and identity/end keys; Rust keeps declaration validation
ownership.pureCreation: saved actor identity and exact creation/receipt/recovery contracts; no build, audio, behavior or renderer dependency
ownership.host: saved-world directory, locks, strict v11 three-file journal and same-origin HTTP boundary
ownership.view: input/review/cancel/reconcile and source navigation; existing animation editor keeps subsequent draft editing

transaction.evidence: bounded frozen scene and de-duplicated definitions, not asset bytes; verify all before publication/recovery
transaction.conflict: external modifications preserved; no blind overwrite

reviewFindings: Independent core/Node/UI review found no blocking issue.
BOM+CRLF workflow exposed readRegistry rejecting a leading BOM; fixed single-prefix parsing while preserving raw bytes.
v10 already supports BOM images: replace outdated rejection test with actual apply and interrupted recovery. v9 keeps its previous prepublication rejection.
Unknown committed response reconciles exact identity, source bytes/hash, scene source revision and relation closure before clearing pending save; close/reopen rereads ready and allocates nothing.
Existing removed animation targets retain navigation; new creation and recovery require all targets to belong to the frozen scene.
limits: starter creates only one linear track and two keys; later fields editor handles expansion
Godot execution tested separately; no Bevy visual support or new installed delivery
